key_insight: The paper shows that a boundary-actuated PPO reinforcement learning controller can stabilize vibrations in a reduced-order Timoshenko-Ehrenfest beam model and is benchmarked against LQR.
engineering_relevance: This matters for vibration suppression in flexible structures where boundary actuation and model reduction must work reliably under actuator constraints.
method: Derive a modified Timoshenko-Ehrenfest beam PDE with simply supported boundaries.
Build a reduced-order model using eigenfunction expansion and truncated Galerkin projection.
Formulate the finite-dimensional control problem as a continuous-time MDP and solve it with PPO; compare against LQR.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a numerical, step-by-step comparison between the PPO-learned controller and the classical LQR regulator, focusing on dissipation behavior and control constraints.
watch_item: Performance depends on the accuracy of the reduced-order truncation, so limited modal retention may miss important beam dynamics.
paper_title: Boundary Control of a Modified Timoshenko-Ehrenfest Beam via Reduced-Order Reinforcement Learning
